source_snapshot.criteria: BMC and system logs contain no errors; no system hang or blue screen occurs; no device is lost.

original_test_intent: Verify that a fully populated SUT repeatedly loses and regains AC power 100 times while recovering BMC and host access, retaining all expected devices, and producing no disallowed BMC/system error, hang or blue screen.
original_method: Bind the exact SUT and AC/PSU topology, preserve the baseline, then have a qualified operator perform exactly 100 approved AC off/on cycles while automation records each physical confirmation, timing, BMC reachability, host readiness, device inventory and complete event evidence before final-state comparison.
manual_activity: A qualified operator controls and confirms each physical AC interruption/restoration and retains facility safety, abort and recovery authority; the owner approves the topology, dwell, storage policy and final power state.
required_inputs: Exact SUT, BMC, PSU, feed and any facility-controller identity
Approved off/on dwell, boot and BMC/OS readiness timeouts for 100 cycles
Dedicated window, operator, storage/quiesce policy and final power state
BMC/OS access with protected secret injection and console/OOB recovery
Thermal, power, boot, device, link, log and evidence-gap abort criteria
safety_requirements: Preserve complete baseline before any approved log clear
Do not place BMC credentials in process arguments or evidence
Do not switch AC automatically unless an explicitly approved supported controller is in scope
Operate only the verified feed and topology under qualified human control
Stop on unsafe power condition, boot timeout, hang, blue screen, reset loop, thermal/power alarm, device or link loss, persistent error or evidence gap
Do not continue merely to reach cycle 100 and do not retry automatically
Leave the SUT and feed in the approved safe final state
agent_execution_scope: Validate identities, expected inventory, timing and evidence capacity
Capture and hash complete pre-cycle BMC/OS/device/sensor/storage baseline
Initialize the cycle ledger and correlate operator confirmations
After each operator-controlled cycle, collect BMC reachability, boot milestones, OS readiness, inventory and complete raw events
Enforce predefined stop gates and preserve the affected cycle
Compare final state and organize evidence without operating unapproved AC controls or issuing a DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Approve the AC/PSU topology, timing, storage policy and abort matrix
Perform or supervise all 100 physical cycles and stop on anomalies
Control any log clear and recovery action
Review the complete ledger and own PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Its operator-performed AC-cycle direction fits the source, but a boot marker plus the last 30 SEL lines cannot prove complete per-cycle recovery or absence of earlier errors, and command-line BMC passwords are unsafe.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use approved target-bound read-only BMC/OS/device/sensor collectors and a tamper-evident ledger around each independently confirmed physical AC cycle; select platform commands only after interfaces and secret handling are approved.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Exactly 100 AC cycles, full CPU/DIMM/HDD/GPU/network population, 30 attended minutes, 720 machine minutes and all no-error/no-hang/no-blue-screen/no-device-loss criteria remain.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Verify topology and inventory, preserve baseline, execute one authorized physical cycle at a time, require complete readiness and evidence before advancing, abort on the first gate failure, then compare final state and ledger completeness.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds exact feed identity, dwell/readiness gates, secret-safe evidence, cycle integrity and stop/recovery controls while retaining the physical 100-cycle test.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A narrow SEL tail or final-only health check cannot prove that every cycle booted cleanly, retained all devices and remained free of transient errors.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Repeated abrupt power loss can corrupt data, stress PSUs/storage and strand the SUT or management path; automation cannot eliminate facility and physical risks.

project_override_considerations: A Project-approved facility power controller may automate switching only with explicit topology binding, interlocks and an attended abort owner; reducing the cycle count is a declared coverage reduction and cannot be presented as full 100-cycle coverage.
expected_evidence: Approved SUT/BMC/PSU/feed topology, expected inventory, operator, timing and abort matrix
Immutable pre-clear BMC/SEL/OS/device/sensor/storage baseline and any approved clear record
Tamper-evident cycles 1-100 ledger with operator confirmation and off/on/boot/readiness timestamps
Complete per-cycle BMC/OS events, reachability, device inventory, sensor and link state
All stop, timeout, hang, blue-screen, reset, error, device-loss and evidence-gap observations
Final device/health comparison, final power state, recovery audit and engineer-owned verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Row 1525 consistently names and describes a 100-cycle AC power test with stability and device-retention criteria. The exact-code row-803 watchdog/WDAT case is an independent physical-row variant and does not create an internal conflict in this row.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The missing topology, timing, operator, access, safety and recovery data are finite owner-supplied execution inputs. They prevent immediate execution but do not make the source intent or acceptance direction irreconcilable.

review_improvement: Keeps DeepSeek's correct physical-operator boundary while converting its narrow, credential-exposing readback into a target-bound 100-cycle evidence and safety contract that proves each named criterion.
independent_technical_reasoning: A final boot and truncated SEL view can hide a failed intermediate cycle, a transient device disappearance or overwritten events. Because the case asserts stability across 100 abrupt interruptions, each cycle is a separate evidence checkpoint and advancement must stop at the first safety, recovery or evidence failure.
